checks.name: Overlook between homes
checks.q: How close do facing homes get to each other?
checks.tolSrc: Massing and plans read to about ±0.5 m. Rounded up.
checks.boundary: Separation is geometry. Whether residents feel overlooked also depends on window placement, glazing, screening and how rooms are used.

checks.name: Glass you can’t reach
checks.q: How much glazing can only be cleaned or replaced from outside?
checks.metric: Glazing not reachable from inside or a balcony
checks.tolSrc: How fixed panes are classified moves the share by about 3 points.
checks.on: Share of glazing with no inside or balcony access
checks.boundary: This flags access, not cost. It does not know your maintenance contract, access equipment or cleaning frequency.

checks.name: Rain noise over bedrooms
checks.q: Are there roofs directly below bedroom windows?
checks.metric: Roof surfaces directly below habitable windows
checks.tolSrc: Counts are whole surfaces, so one surface is a real difference.
checks.on: Count of roof surfaces within 3 m below a habitable window
checks.boundary: A canopy directly below a window is a geometric condition. Whether rain is audible depends on roof build-up and room construction.

checks.name: Step-free route home
checks.q: How far is the longest step-free route from the entrance to a front door?
checks.metric: Longest step-free route, entrance to front door
checks.tolSrc: Routes traced on plan read to about ±2 m.
checks.on: Route length on plan, entrance to the furthest front door
checks.boundary: Route length is geometry. It does not show gradients, door weights or how the route feels to use.

checks.name: Bins & deliveries
checks.q: How far do bins travel to the kerb, and do they cross the entrance?
checks.tolSrc: Massing and plans read to about ±0.5 m. Rounded up.
checks.on: Distance from bin store to the collection kerb
checks.boundary: This measures the route, not collection practice. Local collection rules are not checked.

checks.name: Replacing big equipment
checks.q: Can large plant come out and go back in without demolition?
checks.metric: Clear service route for the largest plant item
checks.tolSrc: Door and corridor widths read to ±0.1 m.
checks.on: Clear width of the plant replacement route
checks.boundary: Needs a plant schedule and a classified service route before anything can be said.

checks.name: Water & debris pooling
checks.q: Are there flat surfaces where water or debris has nowhere to go?
checks.metric: Flat roof or terrace areas with no drain found
checks.tolSrc: Counts are whole areas, so one area is a real difference.
checks.on: Flat areas with no drain object
checks.boundary: A missing drain object may be unmodelled rather than absent. Treat this as a question for the model, not a defect.
